textured-half-sleeve-henley-black.description: A dark take on the Zipsters signature. Short sleeves and an open button placket keep the shape uncluttered; the black color works just as naturally with denim as it does with pleated trousers.
textured-half-sleeve-henley-black.details:
• Black textured Henley
  • Short sleeves
  • Button placket and open neckline

textured-half-sleeve-henley-white.description: White, with a little more character. The visible texture and buttoned neckline give this short-sleeve Henley its identity. Wear it against dark trousers for a clean contrast.

textured-half-sleeve-henley-brown.description: A warm brown Henley with short sleeves and a buttoned neckline. The color brings depth to a simple pairing: blue denim, pale trousers, or the black pieces already in your rotation.

textured-half-sleeve-henley-dark-grey.description: Dark grey gives the signature Henley a quieter edge. Short sleeves frame the textured body, while the open placket breaks up the neckline. Pair it with pleats for a considered, tonal look.

textured-long-sleeve-henley-white.description: The signature neckline, in a long-sleeve expression. White keeps the textured surface in focus, with the button placket adding a simple point of interest. A natural companion to dark pleated trousers.

mesh-tee-black.description: Black mesh with a sporting point of view. The contrasting 86 graphic and open V neckline give this tee a distinctive presence. Keep the styling simple and let the graphic lead.
mesh-tee-black.details:
• Black mesh tee
  • Contrasting 86 graphic
  • V neckline and short sleeves

raw-denim-pants.description: Blue denim with visible contrast stitching and a broad leg line. The pocket detailing brings structure to an otherwise straightforward silhouette. Style with a Henley or a graphic mesh tee.
raw-denim-pants.details:
• Blue raw denim pants
  • Visible contrast stitching
  • Front pockets and belt loops

pleated-suit-pants-black.description: Black trousers with visible front pleats and a long, flowing leg line. They give a simple Henley a more considered finish, without needing much else.
pleated-suit-pants-black.details:
• Black pleated suit pants
  • Front pleats
  • Belt loops and side pockets
